This Privacy Policy describes how Whaleco Inc., a Delaware company ("Temu", "we", "us" or "our") handles personal information that we collect through our digital properties that link to this Privacy Policy, including our website (www.temu.com) and mobile application (collectively, the "Service"), and other activities as described in this Privacy Policy. At Temu, we care deeply about privacy. We strive to be transparent about our privacy practices, including how we treat your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and otherwise process the personal information of our registered account holders, those who purchase items on Temu without an account, and those who browse the Service ("users"). In this Privacy Policy, we also explain the rights you have with regard to your personal information. For more information, see the “<u>Your Rights and Choices</u>” section below. If you are a resident of a U.S. state that has enacted comprehensive privacy legislation (including, for example, the California Consumer Privacy Act and the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act), please see our Privacy Policy Addendum for U.S. Residents for additional information. old: **Interest-based advertising**

We, our service providers, and our third-party advertising partners may collect and use your personal information for interest-based advertising purposes. For example, we may use your interactions with the Service (e.g., your browsing, searching and purchasing history on the Service), and information included in your account profile (e.g., your country if recorded) to show you interest-based advertising on our platform, which displays a merchandise partner’s listing or product more prominently. We do not use information which on its own personally identifies you, such as your name or email address, to show you interest-based advertising. In providing interest-based advertising, we follow the Self-Regulatory Principles for Online Behavioral Advertising as set forth by the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA), which is an advocacy organization for responsible digital marketing and consumer privacy. You can learn more about interest-based advertising and your opt-out choices here.
new: **Advertising**

We and our third-party advertising partners may collect and use your personal information for advertising purposes, including to serve advertisements and to measure the performance of advertisements shown to you. In providing interest-based advertising off the platform, we follow the Self-Regulatory Principles for Online Behavioral Advertising as set forth by the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA), which is an advocacy organization for responsible digital marketing and consumer privacy. We may also use your interactions with the Service (e.g., your browsing, searching and purchasing history on the Service), and information included in your account profile (e.g., your country if recorded) to show you personalized advertised listings on our platform, which display a merchandise partner’s products more prominently. You can learn more about your opt-out choices here.

old: To manage your preferences or opt-out of marketing communications, you can take any of the following actions. Rest assured that you can continue to use Temu even if you opt out of marketing communications.
